en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a hilly townscape. In the foreground are residential houses with steep roofs surrounded by many trees. On the hillside above the town are terraced slopes and a prominent building resembling a small palace or villa with a tower and flag, known as Friedensburg. Further along the ridge are smaller buildings or pavilions. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Kötzschenbroda – Friedensburg, and a small number appears in the lower right corner.
